# Generador de Timelapse Landsat

Aquesta eina et permet crear **timelapses d'imatges de satèl·lit Landsat** directament des del teu navegador usant la teva API de Google Earth Engine. Pots seleccionar qualsevol àrea del món i generar una animació que mostra els canvis en la superfície terrestre des de 1984 fins a l'actualitat.

::: {.callout-note}
## Com usar aquesta eina

1. Escriu el nom del projecte de Google Earth Engine al qual tinguis accés i vulguis usar al camp del panell **Projecte GEE**
2. Obtén el teu **token d'accés** executant al terminal: 
```bash
python3 -c "import ee, google.auth.transport.requests; ee.Initialize(project='your-project-name'); c=ee.data.get_persistent_credentials(); c.refresh(google.auth.transport.requests.Request()); print(c.token)"
```
3. Enganxa el token (comença per `ya29.`) al camp del panell **Token d'accés** i fes clic a **Connectar amb Earth Engine**
4. Dibuixa un **rectangle** o **polígon** al mapa per seleccionar l'àrea
5. Configura les opcions (combinació de bandes, resolució, rang d'anys)
6. Fes clic a **Crear Timelapse** i espera que es generin els fotogrames
7. Descarrega el resultat com a GIF animat
:::

```{=html}
<script>
// ============================================
// GLOBALS
// ============================================

// Auto-update project name in example command
function updateProjectExample() {
    var project = document.getElementById('tl-project').value.trim() || 'your-project-name';
    var codeEl = document.getElementById('tl-example-code');
    if (codeEl) {
        codeEl.innerText = "python3 -c \"import ee, google.auth.transport.requests; ee.Initialize(project='" + project + "'); c=ee.data.get_persistent_credentials(); c.refresh(google.auth.transport.requests.Request()); print(c.token)\"";
    }
}

// Copy example code to clipboard
function copyExampleCode(btn) {
    console.log('[Timelapse] Copy button clicked');
    var codeEl = document.getElementById('tl-example-code');
    console.log('[Timelapse] Code element:', codeEl);
    
    if (!codeEl) {
        console.error('[Timelapse] Code element not found');
        alert('Error: Element de codi no trobat');
        return;
    }
    
    var textToCopy = codeEl.innerText || codeEl.textContent;
    console.log('[Timelapse] Text to copy:', textToCopy);
    
    // Try modern clipboard API first
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(textToCopy).then(function() {
            console.log('[Timelapse] Successfully copied to clipboard');
            // Show feedback
            if (btn) {
                var originalText = btn.innerText;
                btn.innerText = '✅ Copiat!';
                btn.style.background = '#4CAF50';
                setTimeout(function() {
                    btn.innerText = originalText;
                    btn.style.background = '#4285F4';
                }, 2000);
            }
        }).catch(function(err) {
            console.error('[Timelapse] Clipboard API error:', err);
            // Fallback method
            fallbackCopy(textToCopy, btn);
        });
    } else {
        console.log('[Timelapse] Clipboard API not available, using fallback');
        fallbackCopy(textToCopy, btn);
    }
}

// Fallback copy method
function fallbackCopy(text, btn) {
    try {
        var textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textArea.value = text;
        textArea.style.position = 'fixed';
        textArea.style.left = '-999999px';
        textArea.style.top = '-999999px';
        document.body.appendChild(textArea);
        textArea.focus();
        textArea.select();
        
        var successful = document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(textArea);
        
        if (successful) {
            console.log('[Timelapse] Fallback copy successful');
            var btn = event.target;
            if (btn) {
                var originalText = btn.innerText;
                btn.innerText = '✅ Copiat!';
                btn.style.background = '#4CAF50';
                setTimeout(function() {
                    btn.innerText = originalText;
                    btn.style.background = '#4285F4';
                }, 2000);
            }
        } else {
            throw new Error('execCommand failed');
        }
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('[Timelapse] Fallback copy failed:', err);
        alert('Error en copiar. Si us plau, selecciona i copia manualment:\n\n' + text);
    }
}
var map, drawnItems, drawControl, currentGeoJSON = null;
var frameOverlay = null, gifBounds = null;
var frames = [], frameIdx = 0, frameTimer = null;
var frameSpeed = 200, isPlaying = false, stopRequested = false;
var eeReady = false;

var BAND_MAP = {
    'Red': 'SR_B4', 'Green': 'SR_B3', 'Blue': 'SR_B2',
    'NIR': 'SR_B5', 'SWIR1': 'SR_B6', 'SWIR2': 'SR_B7'
};
var BAND_MAP_L5 = {
    'Red': 'SR_B3', 'Green': 'SR_B2', 'Blue': 'SR_B1',
    'NIR': 'SR_B4', 'SWIR1': 'SR_B5', 'SWIR2': 'SR_B7'
};
var BAND_MAP_S2 = {
    'Red': 'B4', 'Green': 'B3', 'Blue': 'B2',
    'NIR': 'B8', 'SWIR1': 'B11', 'SWIR2': 'B12'
};

function updateSensorInfo() {
    var sensor = document.getElementById('tl-sensor').value;
    var info = document.getElementById('tl-sensor-info');
    if (sensor === 'sentinel2') {
        info.innerText = '🛰️ Sentinel-2: resolució 10m, disponible des de 2017. L\'any d\'inici s\'ajustarà automàticament.';
    } else {
        info.innerText = '';
    }
}

// ============================================
// MAP SETUP
// ============================================
map = L.map('tl-map').setView([40.65, 0.6], 8);

var esriImagery = L.tileLayer('https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', {
    attribution: 'Esri', maxZoom: 18
});
var osm = L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap', maxZoom: 19
});
var cartoLight = L.tileLayer('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png', {
    attribution: '&copy; CARTO', maxZoom: 20
});
var cartoDark = L.tileLayer('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png', {
    attribution: '&copy; CARTO', maxZoom: 20
});
var esriTopo = L.tileLayer('https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Topo_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', {
    attribution: 'Esri', maxZoom: 18
});
esriImagery.addTo(map);

L.control.layers({
    'Esri Satèl·lit': esriImagery, 'OpenStreetMap': osm,
    'Carto Clar': cartoLight, 'Carto Fosc': cartoDark, 'Esri Topogràfic': esriTopo
}, null, {position: 'bottomright'}).addTo(map);

// Search control
var SearchControl = L.Control.extend({
    options: { position: 'topleft' },
    onAdd: function(m) {
        this._container = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-search-control');
        this._container.style.cssText = 'background:white;padding:4px;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);margin-left:50px;margin-top:-52px;';
        this._container.innerHTML = 
            '<input id="tl-search" type="text" placeholder="🔍 Cerca..." style="width:200px;padding:4px 6px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:3px;font-size:13px;">' +
            '<div id="tl-search-results" class="tl-search-results" style="position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;background:white;border-radius:0 0 4px 4px;box-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);max-height:200px;overflow-y:auto;z-index:2000;display:none;max-width:200px;"></div>';
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(this._container);
        return this._container;
    }
});
map.addControl(new SearchControl());

// Scale bar
var ScaleBar = L.Control.extend({
    options: { position: 'bottomleft', numSegments: 4 },
    onAdd: function(m) {
        this._container = L.DomUtil.create('div');
        this._container.style.cssText = 'background:rgba(255,255,255,0.85);padding:8px 12px 6px 12px;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);';
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(this._container);
        m.on('zoomend moveend resize', this._update, this);
        this._update();
        return this._container;
    },
    onRemove: function(m) { m.off('zoomend moveend resize', this._update, this); },
    _update: function() {
        var m=this._map, tPx=Math.round(m.getSize().x*0.2), y=m.getSize().y/2;
        var p1=m.containerPointToLatLng([0,y]), p2=m.containerPointToLatLng([tPx,y]);
        var dist=m.distance(p1,p2);
        var nice=[1,2,5,10,20,25,50,100,200,250,500,1000,2000,2500,5000,10000,20000,50000,100000,200000,500000];
        var n=this.options.numSegments, totalDist=0;
        for(var i=0;i<nice.length;i++){if(nice[i]*n<=dist)totalDist=nice[i]*n;}
        if(!totalDist)totalDist=dist;
        var segDist=totalDist/n, barPx=Math.round(tPx*totalDist/dist), segPx=barPx/n;
        var useKm=totalDist>=1000, unit=useKm?'km':'m', bH=8, tH=6, svgW=barPx+2, svgH=bH+tH+22;
        var svg='<svg width="'+svgW+'" height="'+svgH+'" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">';
        for(var s=0;s<n;s++){var x=1+s*segPx;svg+='<rect x="'+x+'" y="0" width="'+segPx+'" height="'+bH+'" fill="'+(s%2===0?'#000':'#fff')+'" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/>';}
        for(var s=0;s<=n;s++){var x=1+s*segPx;svg+='<line x1="'+x+'" y1="'+bH+'" x2="'+x+'" y2="'+(bH+tH)+'" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.2"/>';var d=segDist*s,val=useKm?(d/1000):d;val=Math.round(val*100)/100;var anchor='middle';if(s===0)anchor='start';if(s===n)anchor='end';svg+='<text x="'+x+'" y="'+(bH+tH+13)+'" text-anchor="'+anchor+'" font-size="12" font-family="Arial" font-weight="bold" fill="#000">'+val+'</text>';}
        svg+='<text x="'+(barPx/2+1)+'" y="'+(svgH-1)+'" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-family="Arial" fill="#333">'+unit+'</text></svg>';
        this._container.innerHTML=svg;
    }
});
map.addControl(new ScaleBar());

// North arrow
var NorthArrow = L.Control.extend({
    options:{position:'topleft'},
    onAdd:function(){var d=L.DomUtil.create('div','tl-north-arrow');d.innerHTML='&#9650;<span>N</span>';d.title='Nord';return d;}
});
map.addControl(new NorthArrow());

// Drawing tools
drawnItems = new L.FeatureGroup();
map.addLayer(drawnItems);
drawControl = new L.Control.Draw({
    draw:{polygon:true,rectangle:true,circle:false,circlemarker:false,marker:false,polyline:false},
    edit:{featureGroup:drawnItems}
});
map.addControl(drawControl);

map.on(L.Draw.Event.CREATED, function(e) {
    drawnItems.clearLayers();
    drawnItems.addLayer(e.layer);
    currentGeoJSON = e.layer.toGeoJSON().geometry;
    document.getElementById('tl-create-btn').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tl-coords').innerText = JSON.stringify(
        currentGeoJSON.coordinates[0].map(function(c){return [c[1].toFixed(4),c[0].toFixed(4)];})
    );
    document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '✅ Àrea seleccionada!';
});
map.on(L.Draw.Event.DELETED, function() {
    currentGeoJSON = null;
    document.getElementById('tl-create-btn').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('tl-coords').innerText = '';
    document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '';
});

// Search box
(function(){
    var input=document.getElementById('tl-search'), results=document.getElementById('tl-search-results'), timer=null;
    input.addEventListener('input',function(){
        clearTimeout(timer); var q=input.value.trim();
        if(q.length<3){results.style.display='none';return;}
        timer=setTimeout(function(){
            fetch('https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&limit=5&q='+encodeURIComponent(q))
            .then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(data){
                results.innerHTML='';
                if(!data.length){results.style.display='none';return;}
                data.forEach(function(item){
                    var row=document.createElement('div');row.innerText=item.display_name;
                    row.addEventListener('click',function(){map.flyTo([parseFloat(item.lat),parseFloat(item.lon)],13);input.value=item.display_name;results.style.display='none';});
                    results.appendChild(row);
                });
                results.style.display='block';
            });
        },400);
    });
    input.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')results.style.display='none';});
    document.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(!input.parentElement.contains(e.target))results.style.display='none';});
})();

// ============================================
// GEE AUTHENTICATION
// ============================================
var eeApiLoaded = false;
function loadEEApi(callback) {
    if (eeApiLoaded) { callback(); return; }
    var script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@google/earthengine@0.1.384/build/ee_api_js.js';
    script.onload = function() { eeApiLoaded = true; callback(); };
    script.onerror = function() {
        document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '❌ Error carregant la API d\'Earth Engine';
        document.getElementById('tl-auth-btn').disabled = false;
        document.getElementById('tl-auth-btn').innerText = '🔐 Connectar amb Earth Engine';
    };
    document.head.appendChild(script);
}

function authenticateGEE() {
    var token = document.getElementById('tl-token').value.trim();
    var project = document.getElementById('tl-project').value.trim();
    if (!token) {
        document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '❌ Enganxa el teu token d\'accés.';
        return;
    }
    if (!project) {
        document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '❌ Escriu el teu ID de projecte GEE.';
        return;
    }
    var btn = document.getElementById('tl-auth-btn');
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerText = '⏳ Carregant API...';
    document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '⏳ Carregant API d\'Earth Engine...';

    var authTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
        btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = '🔐 Connectar amb Earth Engine';
        document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '❌ Temps d\'espera esgotat. Verifica el token i el projecte. Revisa la consola del navegador (F12) per a més detalls.';
    }, 30000);

    loadEEApi(function() {
        btn.innerText = '⏳ Connectant...';
        document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '⏳ API carregada. Autenticant...';
        console.log('[Timelapse] EE API loaded, setting auth token...');
        try {
            ee.data.setAuthToken('', 'Bearer', token, 3600, [], function() {
                console.log('[Timelapse] Auth token set, initializing with project:', project);
                try {
                    ee.initialize(null, null, function() {
                        clearTimeout(authTimeout);
                        eeReady = true;
                        document.getElementById('tl-token').value = '';
                        document.getElementById('tl-auth-section').style.display = 'none';
                        document.getElementById('tl-config-section').style.display = 'block';
                        document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '✅ Connectat a Earth Engine (projecte: ' + project + ')';
                        console.log('[Timelapse] Successfully connected!');
                    }, function(err) {
                        clearTimeout(authTimeout);
                        btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = '🔐 Connectar amb Earth Engine';
                        document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '❌ Error en inicialitzar: ' + err;
                        console.error('[Timelapse] Initialize error:', err);
                    }, null, project);
                } catch(e2) {
                    clearTimeout(authTimeout);
                    btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = '🔐 Connectar amb Earth Engine';
                    document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '❌ Error en ee.initialize: ' + e2.message;
                    console.error('[Timelapse] ee.initialize exception:', e2);
                }
            }, false);
        } catch(e) {
            clearTimeout(authTimeout);
            btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = '🔐 Connectar amb Earth Engine';
            document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '❌ Error en setAuthToken: ' + e.message;
            console.error('[Timelapse] setAuthToken exception:', e);
        }
    });
}

// ============================================
// COMPOSITE HELPER
// ============================================
function applyComposite(collection, method) {
    if (method === 'mean') return collection.mean();
    if (method === 'min') return collection.min();
    if (method === 'max') return collection.max();
    return collection.median();
}

// ============================================
// LANDSAT COLLECTION
// ============================================
function getLandsatCollection(roi, year, startMonth, endMonth, bandNames, compositeMethod) {
    var startDate = year+'-'+String(startMonth).padStart(2,'0')+'-01';
    var endDay = new Date(year, endMonth, 0).getDate();
    var endDate = year+'-'+String(endMonth).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(endDay).padStart(2,'0');
    var collections = [];

    function maskAndScale(img, bMap) {
        var srcBands = bandNames.map(function(b){return bMap[b];});
        var scaled = img.select(srcBands).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2).rename(bandNames);
        var qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
        var mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<4).eq(0));
        return scaled.updateMask(mask).clip(roi);
    }

    if (year>=1984 && year<=2012) {
        collections.push(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2')
            .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(startDate,endDate)
            .map(function(img){return maskAndScale(img,BAND_MAP_L5);}));
    }
    if (year>=1999 && year<=2022) {
        collections.push(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2')
            .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(startDate,endDate)
            .map(function(img){return maskAndScale(img,BAND_MAP_L5);}));
    }
    if (year>=2013) {
        collections.push(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
            .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(startDate,endDate)
            .map(function(img){return maskAndScale(img,BAND_MAP);}));
    }
    if (year>=2022) {
        collections.push(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')
            .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(startDate,endDate)
            .map(function(img){return maskAndScale(img,BAND_MAP);}));
    }

    if (!collections.length) return null;
    var merged = collections[0];
    for (var i=1; i<collections.length; i++) merged = merged.merge(collections[i]);
    return applyComposite(merged, compositeMethod);
}

// ============================================
// SENTINEL-2 COLLECTION
// ============================================
function getSentinel2Collection(roi, year, startMonth, endMonth, bandNames, compositeMethod) {
    var startDate = year+'-'+String(startMonth).padStart(2,'0')+'-01';
    var endDay = new Date(year, endMonth, 0).getDate();
    var endDate = year+'-'+String(endMonth).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(endDay).padStart(2,'0');

    if (year < 2017) return null;

    var srcBands = bandNames.map(function(b){ return BAND_MAP_S2[b]; });
    var collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(startDate, endDate)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30))
        .map(function(img) {
            var scl = img.select('SCL');
            var mask = scl.neq(3).and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10));
            return img.select(srcBands).divide(10000).rename(bandNames)
                .updateMask(mask).clip(roi);
        });

    return applyComposite(collection, compositeMethod);
}

// ============================================
// SPECTRAL INDEX COMPUTATION
// ============================================
var INDEX_CONFIG = {
    'NDVI': { bands: ['NIR','Red'],        palette: ['#d73027','#f46d43','#fdae61','#fee08b','#d9ef8b','#a6d96a','#66bd63','#1a9850'] },
    'NDWI': { bands: ['Green','NIR'],      palette: ['#ffffcc','#a1dab4','#41b6c4','#2c7fb8','#253494'] },
    'NBR':  { bands: ['NIR','SWIR2'],      palette: ['#d73027','#fc8d59','#fee08b','#d9ef8b','#91cf60','#1a9850'] },
    'NDBI': { bands: ['SWIR1','NIR'],      palette: ['#1a9850','#91cf60','#fee08b','#fc8d59','#d73027'] }
};

function computeIndex(composite, indexName) {
    var cfg = INDEX_CONFIG[indexName];
    if (!cfg) return null;
    var b1 = composite.select(cfg.bands[0]);
    var b2 = composite.select(cfg.bands[1]);
    return b1.subtract(b2).divide(b1.add(b2)).rename(indexName);
}

// ============================================
// TIMELAPSE CREATION
// ============================================
function createTimelapse() {
    if (!eeReady || !currentGeoJSON) return;
    stopRequested = false;

    var startYear = parseInt(document.getElementById('tl-start-year').value);
    var endYear = parseInt(document.getElementById('tl-end-year').value);
    var startMonth = parseInt(document.getElementById('tl-start-month').value);
    var endMonth = parseInt(document.getElementById('tl-end-month').value);
    var bandValue = document.getElementById('tl-bands').value;
    var isIndex = bandValue.indexOf('idx:') === 0;
    var indexName = isIndex ? bandValue.split(':')[1] : null;
    var bandNames = isIndex ? ['NIR','Red','Green','SWIR1','SWIR2'] : bandValue.split(',');
    var resolution = parseInt(document.getElementById('tl-resolution').value);
    var compositeMethod = document.getElementById('tl-composite').value;

    if (startYear > endYear) {
        document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '❌ L\'any d\'inici ha de ser menor que el de fi.';
        return;
    }

    var sensor = document.getElementById('tl-sensor').value;
    if (sensor === 'sentinel2' && startYear < 2017) {
        startYear = 2017;
        document.getElementById('tl-start-year').value = 2017;
        document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '⚠️ Sentinel-2 disponible des de 2017. Any d\'inici ajustat.';
    }

    var coords = currentGeoJSON.coordinates;
    var roi = currentGeoJSON.type === 'Polygon' ? ee.Geometry.Polygon(coords) : ee.Geometry(currentGeoJSON);

    var coordsList = coords[0];
    var lats = coordsList.map(function(c){return c[1];}), lngs = coordsList.map(function(c){return c[0];});
    gifBounds = [[Math.min.apply(null,lats),Math.min.apply(null,lngs)],[Math.max.apply(null,lats),Math.max.apply(null,lngs)]];

    document.getElementById('tl-create-btn').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('tl-stop-btn').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tl-progress-container').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '⏳ Generant fotogrames...';
    drawnItems.clearLayers();

    frames = [];
    var years = [];
    for (var y=startYear; y<=endYear; y++) years.push(y);
    var total = years.length;
    var monthAbbr = ['','Gen','Feb','Mar','Abr','Mai','Jun','Jul','Ago','Set','Oct','Nov','Des'];

    function processYear(index) {
        if (stopRequested || index >= total) {
            if (!stopRequested) finishTimelapse();
            return;
        }
        var year = years[index];
        var pct = Math.round(((index+1)/total)*100);
        document.getElementById('tl-progress-fill').style.width = pct+'%';
        document.getElementById('tl-progress-text').innerText = 'Any '+year+' ('+(index+1)+'/'+total+')';

        var composite = (sensor === 'sentinel2')
            ? getSentinel2Collection(roi, year, startMonth, endMonth, bandNames, compositeMethod)
            : getLandsatCollection(roi, year, startMonth, endMonth, bandNames, compositeMethod);
        if (!composite) { frames.push({year:year,url:null}); processYear(index+1); return; }

        // Compute index if in index mode
        var visImage = composite;
        var visParams;
        if (isIndex && indexName) {
            visImage = computeIndex(composite, indexName);
            visParams = {bands:[indexName], min:-0.5, max:0.8, palette:INDEX_CONFIG[indexName].palette, dimensions:resolution, region:roi, format:'png'};
            if (indexName === 'NDBI') { visParams.min = -0.3; visParams.max = 0.3; }
        } else {
            visParams = {bands:bandNames, min:0, max:0.3, dimensions:resolution, region:roi, format:'png'};
        }
        visImage.getThumbURL(visParams, function(url) {
            if (stopRequested) return;
            var img = new Image();
            img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
            img.onload = function() {
                var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                canvas.width = img.width; canvas.height = img.height;
                var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
                var label = monthAbbr[startMonth]+'-'+monthAbbr[endMonth]+' '+year;
                ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
                var tw = ctx.measureText(label).width;
                var tx = canvas.width-tw-10, ty = 20;
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
                ctx.fillRect(tx-4, ty-14, tw+8, 20);
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                ctx.fillText(label, tx, ty);
                frames.push({year:year, url:canvas.toDataURL('image/png'), canvas:canvas});
                processYear(index+1);
            };
            img.onerror = function() { frames.push({year:year,url:null}); processYear(index+1); };
            img.src = url;
        });
    }
    processYear(0);
}

function finishTimelapse() {
    var valid = frames.filter(function(f){return f.url!==null;});
    if (!valid.length) {
        document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '❌ No s\'han generat fotogrames vàlids.';
        document.getElementById('tl-stop-btn').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('tl-create-btn').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('tl-progress-container').style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }

    document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '✅ '+valid.length+' fotogrames. Creant GIF...';
    document.getElementById('tl-stop-btn').style.display = 'none';

    updateScrubberRange();
    frameIdx = 0; showFrame(0); startPlayer();

    document.getElementById('tl-pause-btn').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tl-new-btn').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tl-playback-controls').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tl-progress-container').style.display = 'none';

    document.getElementById('tl-opacity').oninput = function() {
        if (frameOverlay) frameOverlay.setOpacity(this.value/100);
    };
    document.getElementById('tl-speed').oninput = function() {
        frameSpeed = parseInt(this.value);
        if (isPlaying) startPlayer();
    };

    try {
        fetch('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gif.js@0.2.0/dist/gif.worker.js')
        .then(function(r){ return r.blob(); })
        .then(function(blob){
            var workerUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            var gif = new GIF({workers:2, quality:10, workerScript:workerUrl});
            valid.forEach(function(f){ gif.addFrame(f.canvas, {delay:200}); });
            gif.on('finished', function(gifBlob) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(workerUrl);
                var url = URL.createObjectURL(gifBlob);
                var dlBtn = document.getElementById('tl-download-btn');
                dlBtn.href = url; dlBtn.download = 'landsat-timelapse.gif'; dlBtn.style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('tl-video-btn').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '✅ Timelapse llest! '+valid.length+' fotogrames.';
            });
            gif.render();
        }).catch(function(err){
            document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '✅ Animació llesta ('+valid.length+' fotogrames). GIF: '+err.message;
        });
    } catch(e) {
        document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '✅ Animació llesta ('+valid.length+' fotogrames). GIF: '+e.message;
    }
}

// ============================================
// VIDEO EXPORT (WebM)
// ============================================
function exportAsVideo() {
    var valid = frames.filter(function(f){ return f.url !== null; });
    if (!valid.length) return;

    var btn = document.getElementById('tl-video-btn');
    btn.disabled = true; btn.innerText = '⏳ Generant vídeo...';

    var firstCanvas = valid[0].canvas;
    var w = firstCanvas.width, h = firstCanvas.height;
    var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    var stream = canvas.captureStream(0);
    var mimeType = MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('video/webm;codecs=vp9')
        ? 'video/webm;codecs=vp9'
        : 'video/webm';
    var recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType: mimeType, videoBitsPerSecond: 2500000 });
    var chunks = [];
    recorder.ondataavailable = function(e) { if (e.data.size > 0) chunks.push(e.data); };
    recorder.onstop = function() {
        var blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: 'video/webm' });
        var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url; a.download = 'landsat-timelapse.webm';
        document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
        btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = '🎥 Exportar vídeo';
    };

    recorder.start();
    var i = 0;
    function drawNext() {
        if (i >= valid.length) {
            setTimeout(function() { recorder.stop(); }, 300);
            return;
        }
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
        ctx.drawImage(valid[i].canvas, 0, 0, w, h);
        stream.getVideoTracks()[0].requestFrame();
        i++;
        setTimeout(drawNext, frameSpeed);
    }
    drawNext();
}

// ============================================
// MAP FRAME PLAYER
// ============================================
function showFrame(idx) {
    var valid = frames.filter(function(f){return f.url!==null;});
    if (!valid.length || !gifBounds) return;
    var op = document.getElementById('tl-opacity').value/100;
    if (frameOverlay) map.removeLayer(frameOverlay);
    frameOverlay = L.imageOverlay(valid[idx].url, gifBounds, {opacity:op}).addTo(map);
    // Update scrubber position and label
    var scrubber = document.getElementById('tl-frame-scrubber');
    var label = document.getElementById('tl-frame-label');
    if (scrubber) scrubber.value = idx;
    if (label && valid[idx]) label.innerText = '📅 ' + valid[idx].year;
}
function updateScrubberRange() {
    var valid = frames.filter(function(f){return f.url!==null;});
    var scrubber = document.getElementById('tl-frame-scrubber');
    if (scrubber) { scrubber.max = Math.max(0, valid.length - 1); scrubber.value = 0; }
}
function scrubFrame(val) {
    var idx = parseInt(val);
    stopPlayer();
    document.getElementById('tl-pause-btn').innerText = '▶ Reproduir';
    frameIdx = idx;
    showFrame(idx);
}
function startPlayer() {
    stopPlayer(); isPlaying = true;
    document.getElementById('tl-pause-btn').innerText = '⏸ Pausa';
    var valid = frames.filter(function(f){return f.url!==null;});
    frameTimer = setInterval(function(){
        frameIdx = (frameIdx+1)%valid.length; showFrame(frameIdx);
    }, frameSpeed);
}
function stopPlayer() { if(frameTimer){clearInterval(frameTimer);frameTimer=null;} isPlaying=false; }
function togglePlay() {
    if (isPlaying) { stopPlayer(); document.getElementById('tl-pause-btn').innerText='▶ Reproduir'; }
    else startPlayer();
}
function stopTimelapse() {
    stopRequested = true; stopPlayer();
    document.getElementById('tl-stop-btn').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('tl-create-btn').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tl-progress-container').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '⏹ Aturat.';
}
function resetTimelapse() {
    stopPlayer(); stopRequested = true;
    if (frameOverlay) { map.removeLayer(frameOverlay); frameOverlay=null; }
    gifBounds=null; frames=[]; frameIdx=0; currentGeoJSON=null;
    drawnItems.clearLayers();
    ['tl-create-btn','tl-stop-btn','tl-download-btn','tl-new-btn','tl-pause-btn','tl-playback-controls','tl-progress-container'].forEach(function(id){
        document.getElementById(id).style.display='none';
    });
    document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '';
    document.getElementById('tl-coords').innerText = '';
    document.getElementById('tl-frame-label').innerText = '';
}
function clearAll() { resetTimelapse(); }
</script>
```

## Sobre els Timelapse Landsat

Els **timelapses Landsat** són animacions creades a partir d'imatges de satèl·lit del programa Landsat de la NASA/USGS, que porta capturant imatges de la Terra des de 1984. Permeten visualitzar canvis com:

- **Expansió urbana**: creixement de ciutats i àrees metropolitanes
- **Desforestació i reforestació**: canvis en la cobertura forestal
- **Canvis en masses d'aigua**: evolució de llacs, rius i embassaments
- **Agricultura**: rotació de conreus i canvis en l'ús del sòl
- **Impacte del canvi climàtic**: retrocés de glaceres, desertificació

### Combinacions de bandes disponibles

- **Red/Green/Blue**: Color real, mostra la superfície tal com la veuríem amb els nostres ulls
- **NIR/Red/Green**: Fals color, ressalta la vegetació en tons vermells
- **SWIR2/SWIR1/NIR**: Útil per detectar incendis i sòls nus
- **NIR/SWIR1/Red**: Combinació per a anàlisi de vegetació i humitat
- **SWIR2/NIR/Red**: Ressalta diferències geològiques i d'ús del sòl

### Requisits

- Un compte de Google amb accés a [Google Earth Engine](https://earthengine.google.com/)
- Navegador modern amb JavaScript habilitat
